title: Musk slows down internet for Ukraine

paragraphs: Recent news reports reveal that Elon Musk personally authorized a slowdown of Starlink, the military-grade satellite network crucial to Ukraine’s defense against Russia.

The restriction severely hampered Ukrainian military operations, affected drone capabilities and missile interceptions. While some US officials suggest Musk acted on his own, other sources indicate he discussed the decision with President Trump and administration members. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed that Starlink service remains limited, though American officials promised to help resolve the issue.

The incident triggered strong outrage in Washington, and lawmakers call for a full investigation into potential contract violations and illegal interference. Commentators and politicians expressed deep concern over the dangerous concentration of geopolitical power in the hands of a single private citizen during wartime.

words.d: to delay something or prevent it from progressing
stopping or catching something before it reaches its destination
breaking a rule, law, or agreement

paragraphs: Reports show that Elon Musk ordered a slowdown of Starlink’s military internet service, which Ukraine relies on to defend itself from Russian attacks. The restriction made it much harder for Ukrainian forces to use drones and protect cities.

While some leaders think Musk acted completely on his own, others say he spoke with President Trump before making the decision. Ukrainian President Zelensky said that connection speeds are still limited, but officials are working to fix the problem.

The situation made many American politicians angry, and they are now demanding a full investigation. Many people believe that an ordinary person shouldn’t have the power to control military decisions or affect international war strategy.

words.d: reducing the speed or activity of something
a rule which controls what can be done

paragraphs: A new report says that Elon Musk slows down the satellite internet for Ukraine. It is called Starlink. Ukraine uses Starlink to fight against Russia.

This makes it very hard for Ukrainian soldiers to use drones and stop rockets. Ukraine’s president says that the internet is still slow, but leaders are trying to fix it. Some people say that Musk talks to Donald Trump first. Others think that he does it alone.
American politicians are very angry. They want to find out what really happens. They believe that one rich man should not have so much power in a war.

words.d: when you can control or have an impact on what happens to other people
